names.note: Read out of the title on her name page, «Елисавета (Самовская), мц.», with the rank word left off. The day's line declines the forename and gives no surname: «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мц. Елисаветы (1937).»

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names her in on 1 ноября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page for her and her name page holds two days and no text.

feast.note: Her name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мц. Елисаветы (1937).»

attestations.note: Her «мц.» is martyr and the line gives her no grade and no office, which is what distinguishes her from the two priests she is named with: she is the one lay person on the line. The surname «Самовская» returns no other folder in the corpus.
